summary_1line: Vidura’s agent guides the escaped Pandavas to a hidden boat, ferries them across the Ganga, while townspeople mourn, believing they perished in the lac house fire.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima strides through the dark forest carrying Kunti on his shoulder and his brothers on his arms and sides, crushing trees under his chest.
On the moonlit banks of the Ganga, Vidura’s agent reveals a swift, flag-marked boat waiting silently for the Pandavas.
Villagers stand before the smoking ruins of the lac house, lamenting as ashes and charred beams glow in the night.
